info.description:
The Outdoorsy API (or simply "API") is organized around REST. It uses
predictable, resource-oriented URLs and implements standard HTTP response
codes, verbs, authentication mechanisms, and a variety of request encodings.

## Versioning

The API implements semantic versioning.

Booking.description:
A booking is a reservation that references the renter, owner, and rental vehicle
with a defined start and stop date

A booking is what we're all about
Booking.title: Booking represents a reservation

affirm_total.description: Dynamically calculated. Not stored in DB

bundle_id.description:
calculated field that holds the result of whether the rental has this assigned
if not, will look at the user/owner

campground_booking_url.description: Contains the booking id so ember can call /bookings/:id/default-selections

can_add_trip_protection.description: CanAddTransaction is used to check if the guest can add a trip protection

can_cancel_trip_protection.description: CanCancelTripProtection is used to check if the guest can cancel a trip protection

can_manage_tax_rates.description: used by dashboard to disable tax editing

cc_fee_percentage.description: Copied rental data - don't want rental changes to affect this booking

dealer_minimum_days.description: used to display information if a booking is below the dealers minimum days

discount_code.description: Copied discount code data, not allowed in request data.

insurance_bundle.description: Using an interface{} to avoid import cycle and from having to move structs into the models package.

non_refundable_total.description:
NonRefundableTotal is the total amount that cannot be refunded to the
renter. Trip Insurance that has been started is an example of something
that would be added to this total

owner_addon_total.description: Sum of all addons (booking items from rental_item parent_item_type)

owner_fee_aggregate_percentage.description: aggregate percentage for all owner fee services that we apply - for UI purpouses

owner_fee_on_renter_cancellation.description:
Cancellation payout details - populated for owner/admin when status is renter_cancelled
Enables the host dashboard cancellation payout breakdown modal (MP-4959)

total_after_deductions.description:
the total amount that we will take from user card/paypal account for a given booking
deprecated use TotalAfterCredits

total_paid_with_claim_adjustments.description: For admin portal current rental paid = booking total_paind + claim adjustments

total_with_claim_adjustments.description: For renter payment detals = total_after_credits (or booking total if not present) + claim adjustments

use_system_tax_rates.description: used by booking details page to display system tax notice

BookingDriver.description: BookingDriver is the driver(s) of the 'rv' rental or the renter of the 'stay' rental

role.description: attrs from Passenger struct so frontend can treat them the same

BookingFeesVariant.description: BookingFeesVariant defines a complete price variant rule

BookingFeesVariantModification.description: BookingFeesVariantModification defines how to modify a price

_deleted.description: special flag for handling batch update/delete

final_payment_due_days.description: 0 - manual charge due at the start of the trip, -1 manual due at the end of the trip, >0 automatic charge N days before trip start

allow_user_refund_method.description: return numbers for display but user may not be allowed to choose

owner_payout_amount.description: show admin what to expect for owner payout

is_taxable.description:
IsTaxable determines whether this service is taxable. This is defaulted
to the service's IsTaxable field on BookingService create

premium_total.description: PremiumTotal is what we pay to the dealer

total.description: Total is the full amount of what the renter pays (total + premium total) - does not include taxes
